mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_subscriptions (user_id, tier, ai_trips_used) VALUES (#{userId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER}, 'FREE', 0) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE user_subscriptions SET ai_trips_used = GREATEST(ai_trips_used - 1, 0), updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} AND ai_trips_used > 0
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= NOW() THEN 'FREE' ELSE tier END FROM user_subscriptions WHERE user_id = #{userId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER}
SELECT expires_at FROM user_subscriptions WHERE user_id = #{userId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} AND tier <> 'FREE' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > NOW())
